title: Initiation of fluoxetine in a pediatric patient with Mucopolysaccharidosis IIIA: Early observations.
figures: Urine heparan sulfate (HS) levels remained above the normal range during the fluoxetine administration period. The significance of fluctuations in urine HS levels is unclear due to limited data about the stability of urine HS levels in individuals with MPS IIIA over time.
